About the School

Shaping Tomorrow's Leaders Since 1997

Quazi Faizur Rahman

Founding Chairman & Founding Principal, Oriental Seminary

The Oriental Seminary is an English Medium School. The medium of instruction is English but the western culture is not the goal and, instead, we look for a modern National stand. Discipline, neatness & punctuality are particularly cared for together with the academic attainments.

Firoza Nasreen

Principal, Oriental Seminary

At Oriental Seminary, we believe that true education goes beyond textbooks. Our mission is to nurture every child's intellect, character, and spirit — preparing them not just for examinations, but for life. We foster curiosity, compassion, and confidence, guided by our motto: Develop Head, Heart & Soul. Every child who walks through our doors is valued, heard, and given the opportunity to grow into the best version of themselves.

Our Guidelines ↗

The Student Oath

"I promise to be true to myself, to my family and to my country.
I further promise to remain loyal to my parents, to my teachers and to other superiors.
And I also promise to be respectful to the religious and social values.
May Almighty help me to so develop."

"আমি শপথ করছি যে আমি আমার নিজের, পরিবারের এবং দেশের প্রতি আন্তরিক থাকব।
আমি মাতা-পিতা, শিক্ষক ও গুরুজনদের অনুগত থাকব।
আরও শপথ করছি যে ধর্মীয় ও সামাজিক মূল্যবোধের প্রতি শ্রদ্ধাশীল থাকব।
মহান স্রষ্টা এ পথে আমার সহায় হোন।"
